propositions: An optional isolated adapter must parse coverage percentage from pytest-cov output in GitHub Actions run logs and CI-health metadata (status, duration, red-to-green recovery) from the GHA API.
A harvester script must read recent run logs and metadata via the Actions API and persist snapshots to the tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson store path, not to gitignored reports/.
The adapter must compute red-to-green recovery interval from a fail-then-pass run pair and extract recheck/flake rates across repeated runs on the same commit.
Core metrics modules must not import the GHA adapter to maintain isolation and portability for future CI backends.
Coverage and CI-health snapshots must be labeled and emitted with source/label metadata so they integrate into the going-forward metrics series.
